summary: Revised implementation plan for the Portfolio AI Assistant for Muhammad Afzal Soomro. Corrects profile data to verified projects (Zentrix Store and Real Estate Lead Management API in progress), uses data/portfolio.json with a validation schema, grounds AI answers with server-validated project IDs, removes exaggerated scalability/security claims, documents in-memory rate limiting trade-offs, adds measurable acceptance criteria across 5 viewport widths (320px, 375px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px), and orders milestones to establish core request flow before enhancements.
